name: zentra
description: Zentra+ — gestion operativa multisucursal para restaurantes, bares y cafeterias

scripts.dev:host: concurrently -k -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "pnpm run dev:api" "pnpm run dev:web"
scripts.seed: docker compose exec api python -m app.seed
scripts.db:psql: docker compose exec db psql -U postgres -d zentra
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d db
scripts.db:revision: docker compose exec api alembic revision --autogenerate -m
scripts.db:migrate: docker compose exec api alembic upgrade head
scripts.db:downgrade: docker compose exec api alembic downgrade -1
scripts.test: pnpm run test:api && pnpm run test:web
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:api && pnpm run lint:web
scripts.format: prettier --write . && uv run --directory api ruff format .
